free_tier.stated: No usable free allowance: 'To use models, create API keys, and access paid platform services, add a credit card. Without a card, you can still view the platform but can't use models or API keys.' A 'Serverless - Free' class limited to 5 requests per minute appears in the rate-limit table, and the pages read do not say how an account reaches it.

tooling: OpenAI-compatible REST at https://api.parasail.io/v1; any OpenAI SDK with a bearer key created at the dashboard
chaining: pay-per-token open-model catalogue behind one OpenAI-compatible base URL; the card on file is the gate before any key works

limits.value: Serverless - Free 5 requests per minute; Serverless - User 500 requests per minute; Enterprise unlimited; token limit not currently enforced on any of them
usage is billed in arrears: the card is charged when accrued usage reaches USD 25, then the remainder at the end of the billing cycle

binding_note: the card requirement is the gate (see identity); past it, the Free class allows 5 requests per minute and the User class 500

identity_cost.detail: the billing documentation states a credit card must be added before models or API keys can be used; card data is processed by Stripe

confidence_note: documentation pages only; the 5 requests per minute class is a documented figure and not measured

evidence.proved: a credit card is required before any model or API key can be used
evidence.quote: To use models, create API keys, and access paid platform services, add a credit card. Without a card, you can still view the platform but can't use models or API keys.

evidence.proved: usage is billed in arrears with a charge at USD 25 accrued
evidence.quote: Parasail automatically charges your card after your organization's accrued usage reaches $25, then reconciles any remaining balance at the end of the billing cycle.

evidence.proved: the Free serverless class is limited to 5 requests per minute with no enforced token limit
the User serverless class is limited to 500 requests per minute
the pricing table lists per-1M-token rates; gpt-oss-20b is USD 0.04 input, USD 0.20 output and USD 0.02 cache read

notes: The 'Serverless - Free' rate-limit row has no matching free-credit statement on the pages read.
